title: Folded Letter
central_conflict: a folded letter was found inside a book with half its address missing
decisive_choice: the paper's watermark named the town's original post office
resolution: asked the postmaster to trace the missing address and returned the letter
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, fox and rabbit discovered a folded letter was found inside a book with half its address missing before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they guessed the destination, but the first delivery reached the wrong house; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized the paper's watermark named the town's original post office; they planned a safer joint response.
With the visiting readers watching, they asked the postmaster to trace the missing address and returned the letter, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: Bell-Shaped Ball
central_conflict: a hollow ball stopped making its cheerful ringing sound
decisive_choice: a loose seam revealed a small metal bead trapped in the lining
resolution: opened the seam carefully and restored the ringing bead before the games
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, fox and rabbit discovered a hollow ball stopped making its cheerful ringing sound before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they shook it harder, but the rattle inside stayed completely still; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized a loose seam revealed a small metal bead trapped in the lining; they planned a safer joint response.
With the visiting readers watching, they opened the seam carefully and restored the ringing bead before the games, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: Thirsty Flower
central_conflict: a rare flower began drooping as its watering can ran dry
decisive_choice: a string could wick water slowly from the bucket into the dry soil
resolution: set up the simple wick and watched the flower recover by morning
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, fox and rabbit discovered a rare flower began drooping as its watering can ran dry before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they carried a bucket uphill, but most water spilled over the rocky path; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized a string could wick water slowly from the bucket into the dry soil; they planned a safer joint response.
With the visiting readers watching, they set up the simple wick and watched the flower recover by morning, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
